tasks.title: Fix NestJS circular dependency between library, plans, tts, auth, and database modules
tasks.description: The NestJS backend has a critical circular dependency: library → plans → tts → auth → common → email → database → server. This blocks code quality improvements and violates architecture best practices. Refactor the circular path by: 1) Extracting shared utilities and interfaces into a 'server/src/shared' module that has no internal dependencies, 2) Moving common error handling, logging, and validation utilities to shared, 3) Reorganizing module imports to break the cycle (library should not import from plans; instead extract a 'LibraryPlanService' to break the dependency), 4) Adding explicit module boundaries with barrel exports to prevent transitive dependencies. Document the new dependency graph and add linting rules to prevent new cycles. This is a critical blocker for other backend improvements.
acceptance_criteria: No circular dependencies detected by 'npm run build' or dependency analysis tools
All modules (library, plans, tts, auth, database) can be imported independently
Shared utilities are centralized in server/src/shared with clear ownership
Documentation updated with new module architecture and dependency rules
Tests pass with new import structure

Apply this pattern to all existing modules.
